title: deaddrop: private drop returns 4.04, spec 18.9 says 4.03
description: deaddrop.rs:1159-1162 returns 4.04 concealing existence (security-positive, documented as matching Python reference) but spec/12-apps.md 18.9 says private drops require matching OSCORE context or return 4.03. Intentional wire-conformance divergence. Fix: reconcile - either update spec text to document the concealment rationale or change code to 4.03; add vector if wire-visible.
close_reason: Evidence-driven spec amendment, no code change: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py deliberately returns 404 for private drops with non-matching context (comment: hide existence) and 403 for group drops; Rust matches. Two independent implementations + security-positive rationale outweighed the spec text, so spec/12-apps.md 18.9 was amended to document 4.04-concealment for private drops and 4.03 for group drops. Tests unchanged and green (27/27). Commit <docs(deaddrop) on main>.
